Use tab to navigate through the menu items.

For over a decade, Assembly has been home to some of Calgary’s brightest tech start-ups and small businesses. Our coworking community dreams big and works hard, and an inspiring number of local success stories have taken shape within our walls.

Assembly occupies the top three floors of a building in Kensington — the retail, dining, and entertainment district just northwest of the downtown core. You’ll find restaurants, coffee shops, and of grab-and-go lunch options in every direction. The riverside pedestrian and cycling pathways are a few blocks away, the Sunnyside and Sunalta C-Train stations are a 15-minute walk, and there are plenty of parking options to choose from.

We’re in this (building) together.

When you join our community, we respect your space. That means we’ll do everything we can to be a good host, like maintaining an environment that’s conducive to business and productivity. We'll also create opportunities to mingle, network, learn, and have fun — but these aspects are always optional, and held in dedicated social spaces that won’t interrupt your work when you’re busy.

Full of people. Full of surprises.

When you do need a break, head up to the rooftop patio for a stunning view of Calgary’s skyline. Join us for food, drinks, and entertainment at our scheduled Blender ™ socials. Stop by the kitchen, the coffee machine, or the Community Space to chat with your neighbours and whoever might have stopped by that day. Plus, every once in a while, look forward to seeing a mysterious gift waiting for you on your desk.

NEW MEMBER OFFER

OR TOUR

FOR QUESTIONS

ABOUT

MEET YOUR HOST

Sonja Bronstein

Assembly Managing Director

Sonja Bronstein has managed Assembly since day one, shaping it to be the bright, welcoming, and productive space it is today. As an alumnus of local success story Veer, Sonja’s a veteran of Calgary’s start-up and tech communities — so she knows firsthand how important culture and environment can be to reaching your goals.

Contact Sonja >>

EXPLORE KENSINGTON

"Whether you want to bike along the river, stroll the neighbourhood while sipping some of Calgary’s finest coffee or spend the night listening to live music – Kensington has it all! Considered Calgary’s Urban Village, Kensington offers a unique, inner-city experience. Located just off the Sunnyside LRT Station and walking distance from downtown, it’s possible to spend an entire day exploring the shops and restaurants, or an entire weekend by staying at one of the beautiful boutique hotels."

<script id="wix-first-paint">
    if (window.ResizeObserver &&
        (!window.PerformanceObserver || !PerformanceObserver.supportedEntryTypes || PerformanceObserver.supportedEntryTypes.indexOf('paint') === -1)) {
        new ResizeObserver(function (entries, observer) {
            entries.some(function (entry) {
                var contentRect = entry.contentRect;
                if (contentRect.width > 0 && contentRect.height > 0) {
                    requestAnimationFrame(function (now) {
                        window.wixFirstPaint = now;
                        dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('wixFirstPaint'));
                    });
                    observer.disconnect();
                    return true;
                }
            });
        }).observe(document.body);
    }
</script>


<script id="scroll-bar-width-calculation">
    const div = document.createElement('div')
    div.style.overflowY = 'scroll'
    div.style.width = '50px'
    div.style.height = '50px'
    div.style.visibility = 'hidden'
    document.body.appendChild(div)
    const scrollbarWidth= div.offsetWidth - div.clientWidth
    document.body.removeChild(div)
    if(scrollbarWidth > 0){
        document.body.style.setProperty('--scrollbar-width', `${scrollbarWidth}px`)
    }
</script>

style="font-size:17px; line-height:1.4em;"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_45 wixui-rich-text__text">For over a decade, Assembly has been home to some of Calgary’s brightest tech start-ups and small businesses. Our coworking community dreams big and works hard, and an inspiring number of local success stories have taken shape within our walls.</span></span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:17px; line-height:1.4em;"> </p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:17px; line-height:1.4em;"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_45 wixui-rich-text__text">Assembly occupies the top three floors of a building in Kensington — the retail, dining, and entertainment district just northwest of the downtown core. You’ll find restaurants, coffee shops, and of grab-and-go lunch options in every direction. The riverside pedestrian and cycling pathways are a few blocks away, the Sunnyside and Sunalta C-Train stations are a 15-minute walk, and there are plenty of parking options to choose from.   </span></span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:17px; line-height:1.4em;"> </p>

<h4 class="font_4 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:30px;"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:30px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_42 wixui-rich-text__text">We’re in this (building) together. </span></span></span></h4>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:17px; line-height:1.4em;"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_45 wixui-rich-text__text">When you join our community, we respect your space. That means we’ll do everything we can to be a good host, like maintaining an environment that’s conducive to business and productivity. We'll also create opportunities to mingle, network, learn, and have fun — but these aspects are always optional, and held in dedicated social spaces that won’t interrupt your work when you’re busy.   </span></span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:17px; line-height:1.4em;"> </p>

<h4 class="font_4 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:30px;"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:30px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_42 wixui-rich-text__text">Full of people. Full of surprises.</span></span></span></h4>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:17px; line-height:1.4em;"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_45 wixui-rich-text__text">When you do need a break, head up to the rooftop patio for a stunning view of Calgary’s skyline. Join us for food, drinks, and entertainment at our scheduled Blender ™ socials. Stop by the kitchen, the coffee machine, or the Community Space to chat with your neighbours and whoever might have stopped by that day.
